questions.q: What is Sailor Moon's civilian name in the original Japanese?
questions.why: Usagi Tsukino becomes Sailor Moon; the DiC dub calls her Serena.

questions.q: Which talking animal mentors Sailor Moon?
questions.why: Luna is a talking black cat with a crescent moon mark.

questions.q: What is Tuxedo Mask's civilian name?
questions.why: Tuxedo Mask is Mamoru Chiba, Prince Endymion's reincarnation.

questions.q: What is the name of Sailor Moon's future daughter, nicknamed Small Lady?
questions.why: Chibiusa is her daughter, Small Lady.

questions.q: Which transformation phrase does Sailor Moon use in the Japanese original?
questions.why: The phrase is Moon Prism Power, Make Up!

questions.q: Which magazine first serialized Sailor Moon in December 1991?
questions.why: Takeuchi's manga began in Kodansha's Nakayoshi.

questions.q: Who voices Sailor Moon in the Japanese anime?
Which Sailor Guardian starred in the one-shot that preceded Sailor Moon?
questions.why: Codename: Sailor V, a 1991 one-shot starring Sailor Venus, preceded the series.

questions.q: In which century does Neo-Queen Serenity, Sailor Moon's future self, rule?
questions.why: Her future self reigns in the 30th century.

questions.q: How many episodes did the original 1990s Sailor Moon anime have?
questions.why: The Toei series ran 200 episodes from 1992 to 1997.
